objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed document that contains content, metadata, and goes through a release lifecycle from creation to archiving

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation identifier

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Consecutive number assigned to the document

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (Policy, Guideline, Work Instruction, Procedural Instruction)

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Selected template for document creation

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status in the lifecycle (Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Main textual and formatted content of the document

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Time period after which validity must be checked

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Primary creator and signer of the document

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons with change rights on the document

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person who checks technical and formal aspects

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person responsible for approving and publishing the document

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person who translates the document to another language

attributes.name: reader_group
attributes.description: User groups with read access to the document

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other referenced documents

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Associated IT applications relevant to the document

attributes.name: company
attributes.description: Company associated with document validity

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Organizational areas where document is valid

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period document is kept before physical deletion

attributes.name: language_version
attributes.description: Language in which document is available

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: Primary language of document content

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled supplementary document subject to the release cycle of the main document

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Attachment content

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status following main document release process

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Validity date synchronized with main document

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Supplementary non-critical information not subject to the release cycle of the main document

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Content of the additional information

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Publication status

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Planned amendment to an existing document without affecting version history

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Creator of the change proposal

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Processing status of the proposal

attributes.name: scheduled_implementation
attributes.description: Whether the proposal is scheduled for implementation

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request to check if a document remains valid after its validity period expires

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Associated document being checked

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Processing status of the request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Document to be invalidated

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: Person creating the override request

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Processing status of the request

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate and restore an archived document

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Document to be reactivated

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: Person creating the reactivation request

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Processing status of the request

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: User groups and persons assigned to receive document notifications or acknowledgements

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: Group of users included in distribution

attributes.name: person
attributes.description: Individual person included in distribution

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: Whether users receive email notification on release

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Whether users must actively confirm receipt

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users with shared roles and permissions

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the user group

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Archive)

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual system user with assigned permissions and roles

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: User identifier

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Assigned system role

attributes.name: permissions
attributes.description: Access rights to documents and functions

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature applied by workflow participants

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: Person who applied the signature

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of signature

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: Step in which signature was applied (Creator, Review, Release)

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Modification of document metadata and attributes

evts.description: Addition of a controlled supplementary document

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Addition of supplementary non-critical information

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Proposal of planned amendment to existing document

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Document submitted to reviewers for checking

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks technical and formal aspects

evts.name: reject_at_review

evts.name: approve_for_release
evts.description: Reviewer approves document for release step

evts.name: submit_for_release
evts.description: Document submitted to releaser for approval

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves and publishes document

evts.name: reject_at_release
evts.description: Releaser rejects document during release step

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Author signs document creation

evts.name: sign_review
evts.description: Reviewer applies signature during review

evts.name: sign_release
evts.description: Releaser applies signature during release

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachment for archiving

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of new version of released document

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System generates request to check document validity

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Decision to maintain document validity and extend valid until date

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Request to invalidate and archive document

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declaration of document as out of force and archiving

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Request to reactivate archived document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation and restoration of archived document

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Send email notification to users about released document

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request users to actively confirm receipt of document

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: User confirms receipt and acknowledgement of document

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document to another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Checking of translated document

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approval and publication of translated document

Reader group has read access to document
Change proposal belongs to and is displayed in document
Request is linked to document being checked
Request references document to be invalidated

Additional information is associated with document

Users in distribution list requested for acknowledgement
